svg.title: One directory per algorithm
svg.desc: One defineVisualization call registers an algorithm directory, adding a catalog card and a hash route. Steps: 1. Each algorithm is one self-contained directory. 2. One defineVisualization call registers it. 3. The registry adds a catalog card and a hash route. 4. Shared instruments do the playback and drawing. Sources: Algorithm Visualizer README.

text.tspan: Each algorithm is one self-contained directory.
The registry adds a catalog card and a hash route.
Shared instruments do the playback and drawing.
One defineVisualization call registers an algorithm directory, adding a catalog card and a hash route.
